policy: No normalization is represented as a literal source rule. Unresolved qualitative semantics remain visible and do not silently delete raw source formations from coverage telemetry.

frozen_initial_normalizations.definition: Strict completed three-bar pivot: center high > both adjacent highs or center low < both adjacent lows.
BOS publishes on completed candle close beyond the relevant protected structural level; wick-only crossing does not publish BOS.
frozen_initial_normalizations.purpose: Deterministic causal break publication while keeping wick sweeps separate.

frozen_initial_normalizations.definition: Three-candle wick gap: bullish if bar3.low > bar1.high; bearish if bar3.high < bar1.low; no minimum gap threshold.
frozen_initial_normalizations.purpose: Encode source neighboring-shadow inefficiency geometry without a hidden size filter.

frozen_initial_normalizations.definition: Raw candidate only: sweep a known level and close back on the pre-sweep side; exact source-valid three-candle pattern remains unresolved.
frozen_initial_normalizations.purpose: Preserve sweep/body-rejection opportunities without falsely claiming a complete SFP trade rule.
